title: Step-Dad Watches His Step-Child Get Beat Up After Disrespecting Him
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On March 23rd, 2024. Officers responded to domestic dispute regarding a step-dad calling his neighbors kid to fight his step-child after they got into a heated altercation. It started when the step-child got angry and pushed and punched his step-father over "curtains". The mom and dad were subsequently arrested for their involvement in their child get beat up while the kid was arrested for punching and pushing his dad. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
